schema: Approximate hand-inspected pixel coordinates on raw 1254x1254 images; not segmentation masks. Each box [left,top,right,bottom].
animationCautions: Tail joins hindquarters at far right; its free tip is bottom-center, so anchor right and animate tip gently.
Body/markings drift slightly between generated poses: crossfade states, or use one common body and only extracted head states. Direct frame swaps may shimmer.
Do not use pure-white color key: white chest and paws are identity features. Connected exterior segmentation is required on checkerboard images.
Use small feathered deformations; coordinates include background and require existing alpha/masks.
identityAssessment: Strong overall preservation of brown-black classic tabby swirl pattern, forehead M, tan bridge/pinkbrown nose, sagegreen eyes, white chest/paws, plain brown collar. Face has slightly enlarged expressive eyes compared with loaf photo but remains natural adult cat. Art is clearly painterly rather than photo cutout. Back stays long/stocky, complete curved tail, amber upper-right and cool left light. Brown muzzle vibrissae pads are consistent with actual pet photos, with white lower muzzle/chin. Third pose is contented closed-eye chin-up rest rather than full sleeping curl.
